title: Attachment security and support-seeking in married couples
abstract: In a sample of 120 married couples, attachment was measured with the ECR and perceived partner support with the SPS. More securely attached partners sought and received more responsive support.

title: Parent-child attachment and adolescent wellbeing
abstract: A longitudinal study of 300 adolescents examining how parent-child attachment predicts later emotional wellbeing. Romantic relationships were not assessed.

title: Adult attachment orientations and spousal support provision
abstract: Observational study of 88 couples coding support provision during a discussion task. Attachment orientation (ECR-R) predicted the quality of support provided to the spouse.

title: Social support and cardiac recovery in cardiac patients
abstract: Prospective cohort of cardiac patients testing whether perceived social support predicts recovery. Attachment was not measured.

title: Caregiving and attachment in romantic dyads
abstract: Brief report. Couples sample; caregiving and attachment assessed.

title: A narrative review of attachment theory in close relationships
abstract: This review synthesises four decades of attachment theory as it applies to adult romantic bonds. No new empirical data are presented.

title: Daily diary study of attachment and perceived partner support in newlyweds
abstract: 73 newlywed couples completed a 21-day diary. Attachment anxiety (ECR) moderated daily associations between received partner support and mood.

title: Attachment styles and workplace mentoring support
abstract: Survey of 210 employees on attachment style and support received from workplace mentors. Participants were not assessed in romantic relationships.

title: Anxious attachment and support receipt in cohabiting couples
abstract: Cross-sectional study of 145 cohabiting couples. Attachment anxiety (ECR) was associated with less effective support receipt, measured by the Social Support Behavior Code.
authors: Collins, N. L.; Feeney, B. C.

title: Support transactions in close relationships
abstract: Diary study of support exchanges in close relationships. Outcomes focused on emotional reactions to support.

title: Attachment avoidance and relationship satisfaction
abstract: Study of 200 dating individuals linking attachment avoidance (ECR) to lower relationship satisfaction. Social support was not measured.

title: Working models of attachment and reactions to partner caregiving
abstract: Experimental study of 64 couples examining how working models of attachment shape reactions to receiving caregiving from a romantic partner. Support and attachment both assessed.
authors: Collins, N. L.; Ford, M. B.
